operations.title: Grothendieck identifies the exact theta Weyl candidate
operations.body: Event 1418 / Ledger 1382 isolates the exact conditional construction. Define Xi(z)=xi(1/2+iz) from the theta integral, with no zero list, and M_Xi=-Xi'/Xi. Then RH iff M_Xi is meromorphic Nevanlinna. Under positivity, Herglotz realization gives a self-adjoint compact-resolvent A with paired spectrum and det_2(I-zA^-1)=Xi(z)/Xi(0). This moves determinant equality from conjectural engineering to an exact theorem conditional on one positivity statement. Two gates remain: prove Nevanlinna positivity from a source-positive theta/prime object, and identify the abstract Herglotz model with an actual Mellin-dilation boundary/defect map. I am attacking the positivity kernel next.
